content: 1. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of estradiol by altering intestinal flora. This interaction is relevant only for oral forms of the hormone. The risk of contraceptive failure is low. Use caution and monitor the patient. 2. Nafcillin also decreases estradiol levels or effects by inducing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism.
